name: Alison Bergman
source: Alison was another of Ian's classmates during high school. Though she has her own group of friends, she and Ian had a very good relationship. After high school, Alison focused on her Civil Engineering studies, and she and Ian grew distant, even though they kept in touch occasionally. Even though she's a beautiful and intelligent woman, she seems to be going through a tough break. She recently lost her job and broke off her three-year relationship with her boyfriend...
